items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: He was a trumpet player on a different type. He had a swell, round tone and clean, clean, clean.

ctx.x: What about Kid Rene? How did he compare?

He was a trumpet player on a different type. He had a swell, round tone and clean, clean, clean. I mean, him and Louis Armstrong were about the only two I know on that tone type. It's just a tone. I mean, I heard a lot of trumpet players. I mean, they imitate you, you know, close. A shocker. A shocker played more like Rene than anybody I heard yet. He's styling everything.
Is Rene pretty loud or soft?
